purpose: Teach: 出撃/前途/可否/押え/広義/互角/前段/奔走

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新製品の発売出撃日を決めましょう
lines.en: Let's lock down the launch date for the new product.
lines.style: Measured, direct. The tone of someone moving through a checklist with purpose. Steady pacing, no rush. A leader who expects agreement without needing to ask twice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人の前途を応援します
lines.en: Yes. I'm ready to support the new hire's development.
lines.style: Attentive and earnest. Quick affirmation. The ease of someone who knows their role and is ready to step into it. Slightly warm beneath the efficiency.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 値上げの可否を会議で決めましょう
lines.en: We should discuss the price increase in the meeting and decide there.
lines.style: Clear directive. Matter-of-fact cadence. No softening, no apology for asking. The way a manager outlines what needs to happen next, expecting competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経費を押え込む案を提示します
lines.en: Understood. I'll bring a proposal on cost containment.
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgement. Leans into the task. A slight uptick in energy—showing he's taking mental notes and will deliver. Reliable, specific, ready.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 広義の競合分析を進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move forward with a broader competitive analysis.
lines.style: Same register as before. A touch of patience in the pacing—this is layered work. Still directive, but inviting collaboration through the word 'forward.' Expectant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。価格は他社と互角になるよう設定します
lines.en: Got it. I'll make sure the pricing lands at parity with competitors.
lines.style: Nods and pivots to specifics. Calm, methodical. He's already running the scenario in his head. The tone of someone who has done this before and knows what it takes.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プレゼンの前段で背景を説明しましょう
lines.en: We'll walk through the context before we get to the pitch.
lines.style: Measured, slightly slower. The shift to executive presence. Laying groundwork before the close. Still matter-of-fact, but with the weight of someone who knows this moment matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規取引先開拓に奔走しております
lines.en: Understood. I'm already actively pursuing new business partnerships.
lines.style: Final beat. A touch of urgency beneath the surface—he's not waiting for permission, he's already in motion. Steady, professional, but with a hint that he's carrying more than just this conversation. Slight fadeout on the trailing phrase.
